t: Before, an employee opened the CRM,
wrote a message, set the next task
Now AI agents are taking this work
The agent gets a new lead
reads the history, finds the stage
replies, updates CRM, sets a task
Staff no longer live inside the CRM
CRM becomes a system AI works with
The question isn't which CRM to buy
but how much of it AI can do
what to give the agent, what to keep
